_about: Two made-up practice papers written by PrepLoop so a new learner can try importing, solving, reviewing and repeated models before they have papers of their own. NOT questions from any real exam. The same question types appear in both sets on purpose (different numbers), so repeated models has something to show. Regenerate the PDFs with: python scripts/make_sample_papers.py
notice: SAMPLE PAPER - made up by PrepLoop for trying the app.
These are not questions from any real exam.
